targets.title: With a clean conscience: Cleanliness reduces the severity of moral judgments.
targets.evidence_quote:
Reference to Original Report of Finding
Schnall, S., Benton, J. and Harvey, S. (2008). With a clean conscience: Cleanliness reduces the severity of moral judgments. Psychological Science, 19, 1219-1222.
targets.outcome_quote: Those primed with cleanliness rated the behaviors less severely than did those in the control group, t(58)=-1.8, p<.04. This result is consistent with the results of the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The primary report explicitly labels this a successful replication and confirms agreement with original results.
